model.title: Affordable Innovation for the Grid Act
model.meta: Energy and Commerce Committee · Rep. Diana Harshbarger (R-TN)

summary.text: The bill would require the Department of Energy to assess how artificial intelligence and high-performance computing technologies could improve the nation's bulk-power system—the network that generates and transmits electricity across the country—by enhancing its capacity, reliability, and operational efficiency.
